welcome.subject: Welcome to Eventtz
welcome.html:
Hello Jane Doe 👋

Welcome aboard. Whether it is your next owambe, birthday or baby shower, we are here to help you find vendors you can trust.

A gentle start

Here is how most people use Eventtz when planning an event. No rush; browse at your own pace.

First step

See prices before you DM

No more "how much?" in Instagram comments and DMs. Browse vendors with their services and prices already listed.

When you are ready

Send one proper request

Found someone you like? Pick the service, add your date and venue, and send a booking request. Everything stays on one thread.

Sort the details

Talk it through on Eventtz

Need to tweak the menu, add extra hours, or change the guest count? Message the vendor and agree the plan without leaving the app.

When you are happy

Pay with peace of mind

The vendor confirms the final price first. You pay when the details are clear, not before. We hold your payment safely until the event is done.

Ready when you are: browse vendors and send your first request.

Find vendors

Got questions? Reply to this email or write us at hello@eventtz.com. We are happy to help.

Kind regards,
The Eventtz team

Hello Jane Doe,

Welcome aboard. Whether it is your next owambe, birthday or baby shower, we are here to help you find vendors you can trust.

Here is how most people use Eventtz when planning an event. No rush; browse at your own pace.


- First step: See prices before you DM
  No more "how much?" in Instagram comments and DMs. Browse vendors with their services and prices already listed.


- When you are ready: Send one proper request
  Found someone you like? Pick the service, add your date and venue, and send a booking request. Everything stays on one thread.


- Sort the details: Talk it through on Eventtz
  Need to tweak the menu, add extra hours, or change the guest count? Message the vendor and agree the plan without leaving the app.


- When you are happy: Pay with peace of mind
  The vendor confirms the final price first. You pay when the details are clear, not before. We hold your payment safely until the event is done.



Ready when you are: browse vendors and send your first request.
Find vendors: https://www.eventtz.com/client/browse

Got questions? Reply to this email or write us at hello@eventtz.com. We are happy to help.

Kind regards,
The Eventtz team
Eventtz Ltd

welcome.subject: Welcome to Eventtz
welcome.html:
Hello Jane Doe 👋

Welcome aboard. Eventtz is where clients find you, and where you keep bookings, messages and payments in one calm place.

How it works for vendors

A short tour of what happens once your profile is live. Take it step by step; we are here if you need a hand.

Start here

Show clients what you do

Add your photos, services and prices so people know what you offer before they reach out. A clear profile invites the right enquiries.

New business

Requests come to you

When a client wants to book you, you get the date, venue and service in one place. No more lost WhatsApp chats.

Stay in sync

Quote and agree in one chat

Talk through the details with your client and send a clear quote without switching apps.

Get paid

Payments handled properly

Clients pay through Eventtz once the booking is confirmed. Your payout goes to you via Stripe Connect.

When you have a quiet moment, finish your profile so clients can discover you with confidence.

Go to your dashboard

Questions? Reply to this email or write us at hello@eventtz.com. We are glad you are here.

Kind regards,
The Eventtz team
Eventtz Ltd
